profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Staten Island, New York, United States
profile.summary: Computer engineer with experience in software engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Worked remotely to integrate hardware and software design for energy management system
- Review schematic design for battery energy system and ensure compliance to UL1741
- Support verification and testing of battery components
- Program embedded Linux device capable of bluetooth pairing with phone app
- Develop system design document to meet customer requirements
- Develop SCADA control software, enabling remote scheduled control through Modbus and CAN bus
- Industrial Windows 10 machines running Docker containers for Node-red and Azure IoT Edge

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Working closely with Zync UltraScale MPSoC each running VxWorks
- CPLD’s for power management and FPGA’s for interfacing with peripheral devices as well as clock synchronization
- Working in VxWorks RTOS environment in large-scale C++ codebase
- Implementation of power on self tests and periodic built in tests
- Implement interrupt tree mapping board level interrupts to system level interrupts
- Integrate the inertial measurement unit (IMU)
- Create regressions tests in Python scripts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- ARM Cortex-M3 Microcontroller development with C and Assembly in Eclipse
- Xilinx Spartan FPGA bring up, debug and verification
- Create high performance laser system applications focusing on scalability, usability, and maintainability
- GUI development with C# in Visual Studio
- Python and Windows PowerShell scripting to conduct long term tests
- Verification and testing using oscilloscope, logic analyzer and multimeter
- Driving and testing stepper motors, choosing the correct hardware for optimal output
- Integrate hardware and software by reviewing electrical designs used for ADC’s
- Working with laser scientists and laser production team to improve laser performance and decrease laser production time
- Document and maintain version control of software
